title: A new Space that picked a look starts with that theme's General kit as its published website
detail: SYS-8 (website half) of the Mega Theme build plan. createSpace, after applyMegaTheme lands, calls publishStarterSite: it loads the theme's niche-free General kit, applies it with the editor's block defaults, and saves it as the published website through save_website_editor at revision 0, so a Space that already has a website is never replaced. Blocks stay flagged sample. Best-effort and logged. NOT in this row: the lead page and the welcome email (SYS-8 remainder, SYS-17), the subdomain attach (an ops step, never called live until the URL loads), and the headless Wizard probe.

verify.evidence: vitest lib/spaces/starter-site.test.ts passes: a General kit per Mega Theme that applies to a publishable website on its own theme.
